**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 75 **Archetype** [Thlipit Contestant](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=224) **Prerequisites** [Thlipit Contestant Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5474) **Requirements** You have a creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) with your lash. --- You wind your lash around your opponent, then spin them rapidly to discombobulate them. You release your opponent, sending them wobbling 10 feet in a direction of your choice; this is [forced movement](/Rules.aspx?ID=451). Your opponent must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC, with the following effects. **Failure** The target is [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=63) until the end of their next turn. They are then temporarily immune to being confused or [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) by Spinning Release for 10 minutes, though the ability can still be used to move them.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is also sickened 1 from being spun around.
